segments.source: Overview

segments.contextBefore: Add a scene to your article to create special effects.
segments.contextAfter: Apple News Format provides animations (see [`About Component Animations`](about-component-animations.md)) and behaviors (see [`About Component Behaviors`](about-component-behaviors.md)) to use with individual components in your article, but you can also use a *scene* — a combination of animations and behaviors — to control how a section or chapter of your article comes into view.
segments.documentTitle: Adding a Scene to a Chapter or a Section Header

segments.source: Apple News Format provides animations (see [`About Component Animations`](about-component-animations.md)) and behaviors (see [`About Component Behaviors`](about-component-behaviors.md)) to use with individual components in your article, but you can also use a *scene* — a combination of animations and behaviors — to control how a section or chapter of your article comes into view.
